input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: shift-roster-builder flagship: test a 4 s repair reserve against the 2 s default (pre-registered)

errors.what: Wrote a README line blaming the repair's 60-round limit before measuring it; a 180-round run showed rounds change nothing, corrected to the node budget in the same PR.

doc_friction.issue: The previous section said the 2 s reserve's repair ran 0.5-1.2 s without saying what stopped it; the next item ('a longer reserve (4 s)') assumed time was the limit, when the 3M node budget is. Worth recording the stopping cause next to any timing.
The stop hook asks to commit untracked files while a long eval is still writing its .jsonl; writing in-progress output to the scratchpad and copying it in at the end avoids partial commits.

deviations.why: The flagship's next item proposed 4 s 'on the same fresh seeds' (13-24); I used new seeds 25-36 so the pre-registered test was not run on seeds that had already shaped the previous decision.
deviations.result: a clean refusal: 11 better / 27 worse, -64 h

deviations.why: venture-preflight.mjs checks site-wide page surfaces; this PR changed only an eval, a README section, a code comment and a post
deviations.did: skipped it, ran the venture's test suite and the post checks instead

notes: Pre-registered (eval/repair-reserve-4s-prereg.md): 4 s reserve vs 2 s default, 4 above-floor weeks x seeds 25-36: fewer open on 11, more on 27, tied 10, net -64 h, one-sided p = 0.997, rule not met, default stays 2 s. Repair ran 1.2 s either way. Exploratory: 180 rounds identical on 4 builds; 9M nodes repair 2.3 s, 342 gains, still -47 h vs 2 s. Code change: calc.mjs comment only. Verification: node --test repair-flow.test.mjs 6/6; run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder (see PR); post front matter, links and similarity checks clean. The commit-level venture-preflight was skipped: no page, route or user-facing surface changed.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an OR engineer pre-registering, running and writing up 3 x 48-build timing experiments

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
